cc:Work.dc:title: G2 · observed behavior opportunity ratios
cc:Work.dc:description: fresh_start_v1 · completed greedy full-game DEV evaluation · 4,096 paired worlds per comparison, original champion baseline. Ratios pool chosen/opportunities per arm. Paired student-minus-champion 95% WORLD bootstrap resamples both arms' components together. Denominators shown explicitly. Hollow diamonds mark degenerate empirical bootstrap CIs; they cannot quantify unobserved-event uncertainty. Policy-dependent opportunity cohorts are descriptive, not causal. No margins; no training game win-rate claim.

g.text: Positive spend · menus offering a purchase
Smith: high HP; rest may be unavailable.
Potions: per combat menu, not per game/fight.
Card skip: explicit 'skip card reward' only; proceeding
past an untaken card is not counted.
Each gold/potion/relic pick on the same rewards
Zero purchases do not establish population absence
or zero uncertainty. N/A = undefined, never zero.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: fresh_start_v1 · completed greedy full-game DEV evaluation · 4,096 paired worlds per comparison, original champion baseline.
Ratios pool chosen/opportunities per arm. Paired student-minus-champion 95% WORLD bootstrap resamples both arms' components together.
Denominators shown explicitly. Hollow diamonds mark degenerate empirical bootstrap CIs; they cannot quantify unobserved-event uncertainty.
Policy-dependent opportunity cohorts are descriptive, not causal. No margins; no training game win-rate claim.
